purpose: Internal checklist to deliver onboarding support consistently while respecting external boundaries.
usage: Use after mutual interest is clear and before first patient session. Tick practice-owned items only. External items are tracked, not approved by WMC.

sections.title: Before sharing this matrix with a doctor

items.task: Confirm mutual interest for a conversation about onboarding (not an offer guarantee)
Share capability matrix with short disclaimer: support ≠ guarantee; WMC does not issue provider numbers
Offer Provider Number Readiness and DPA/19AB Navigator as exploration tools if relevant
Prepare verified practice location pack (legal name, address, any location identifiers used)
Confirm doctor understands Services Australia issues provider numbers — WMC does not
Record application status as awaiting_external when lodged; do not mark complete until doctor confirms SA outcome
Schedule Medicare billing workflow walkthrough for this practice
Assign early-week billing contact for questions
Avoid personal eligibility determinations; refer to Services Australia resources when asked
Book orientation covering layout, emergency, privacy, contacts, hours
Provide relevant practice policies after mutual confirmation
Sight AHPRA and indemnity evidence (track only — WMC does not grant registration)
Complete identity verification required for system access
Request clinical software login / permissions
Deliver supervised software walkthrough (notes, results, prescribing, recalls)
Arrange nursing team introduction and scope overview
Explain same-day support request pathways
Do not promise dedicated nursing cover beyond current roster capacity
Introduce reception contacts and messaging habits
Explain booking patterns, HotDoc visibility, and running-late expectations
Orient to privacy, records, recalls, and local pathology/radiology workflows
Note accreditation / quality touchpoints relevant to consulting GPs
Check rooms and nursing cover before proposing sessions
Document draft session plan for mutual review
Do not promise patient volume, earnings, or fill rates
Introduce consulting GPs and key team members on consulting days
Schedule a brief early-week check-in for questions and friction points
If registrar pathway: confirm formal supervision separately — collegial welcome is not supervision approval
Update plan status to settling or complete; keep awaiting_external visible if still open
Ensure notes never claim WMC approved provider numbers, visas, DPA, or s19AB
